name: test-strength-rows
brief: Close five test-strength backlog rows in src/DungeonMaster.Tests as five serial test-only tasks, each shown able to fail by an injected defect that is reverted and hash-checked. T1 replaces IconFontFixture's ElementTag regex with an XDocument walk and adds two facts for an icon-font element carrying '>' inside an attribute value. T2 feeds TrueTypeCmapTests' combined-cmap fact a format-0 code below 0x41 so a broken format-0 loop turns it red. T3 arranges a non-empty List<FloorDto> in GetDungeonDetailQueryHandlerTests and asserts the instances are untouched by reference. T4 makes the FloorDragHandle Label and FloorExpandToggle Button element-type assertions require the MAUI default namespace, leaving ThemeSource.QualifiedElementName alone. T5 replaces the SpinWait clock wait in DungeonLastModifiedOnFailedMutationTests with a reflection backdate to 2000-01-01 UTC, and verifies the whole solution at the tip (217/1014/146). Gate 3 removes the five rows; the session reaches main by a PR on test/test-strength-rows.
